owner_request: Let's do the 5 seconds and the 15 seconds test. generate to different test to be able to compare results. organize and improve idea
purpose: Compare two independent continuous Wan clips with duration as the primary changed variable

proposed_terms.allocation_retry: Exact explicit HTTP 400 no-capacity only; same signed H100/location profile and deadline; fresh quote; no uncertain-outcome retry

shared_settings.prompt: One small blue sailboat with a single white sail moves slowly from left to right across a calm lake at sunrise. A fixed wide camera keeps the entire boat visible. Keep the boat's shape, sail, colors, shoreline and mountains consistent. Gentle continuous ripples, natural light, one uninterrupted shot, no cuts, no text.

cases.goal: Establish quality, runtime and memory baseline
Measure longer-shot continuity, temporal drift and resource growth

execution_gates: Implement and verify durable benchmark telemetry before any new paid run
Enable the 15-second experiment only under its separately signed scope; preserve historical five-second limits
Implement two ordered attempts on one Pod under one shared deadline/reservation
Five-second output must be valid, saved off-Pod and its telemetry acknowledged before claiming the 15-second attempt
Check remaining time and measured resource use before the 15-second attempt; skip safely if unsuitable
Never stitch, loop, stretch or recycle the five-second clip to label it as a continuous 15-second test
Preserve the exact historical unknown exception, reservations and independent cleanup
Build and verify the reviewed worker digest; finish fictional checks and host acceptance before admission
Use one new owner-approved comparison scope; never reset an earlier grant
Verify both retained outputs after Pod deletion
deliverables: 5-second MP4 comparison copy and original take
15-second MP4 comparison copy and original take, if successful
Common first-five-seconds side-by-side comparison, plus the full long clip
Timing, memory, cost and technical-validation table
Owner live-review checklist for continuity and visual quality
limitations: 15-second support is not currently enabled or GPU-validated
Longer duration can require more than proportionally greater compute or memory; no guaranteed 3x cost estimate
One pair is an exploratory comparison, not a statistical benchmark
Final one-second billing remains pending; do not equate empty billing records with zero cost
The proposed application limits are not a provider-side hard account cap
approval_reference: John: yes I approve, in direct response to PR #86 proposal: $5 additional total / $4.50 hourly / 45 minutes / one H100 / two ordered renders. Implementation, deployment and bounded execution authorized.
